name: Specter

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.effect: Target's maximum HP is reduced by the damage dealt until a long rest. If max HP reaches 0, the target dies and rises as a Specter in 1 minute.

actions.name: Terrifying Moan
actions.effect: All creatures within 6m must pass WILL save or be frightened for 1 round.

reactions.name: Phase Shift
reactions.effect: When targeted by a non-magical physical attack, the attack passes through the Specter harmlessly.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Can move through creatures and objects. Takes 2d6 force damage if ending its turn in an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: In sunlight, the Specter has -1d6 to attack rolls and saves.

lore: Specters are wrathful spirits of mortals who died in anguish. Unlike ghosts, they retain no memory of their former lives, only an overwhelming hatred of the living and a desperate hunger for their life force.
